title: docs(skills): objectstack-data security.md teaches that a package's sharing rule resolves its queue recipient from its package
body:

_Requested by **Steedos** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9Ubb?thread=cmsg_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9UbbFxEKiXgxakmwSrdiRAhytb)_

Fixes #31735

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：发布的 `objectstack-data` 技能 `rules/security.md` 补了一条：软件包里声明的共享规则把队列当接收方时，队列名先找本包的队列，再找它声明依赖的包（加 `sys`）里唯一的那个；都没有包声明时才落到组织自建的 `sys_queue` 行。三种拒绝各带例子和引擎的拒绝码：范围外 `outside-closure`（含只有环境项持有）；两个依赖都持有 `ambiguous-in-closure`；规则能找到的那个之外还有一个非依赖包持有 `ambiguous-in-environment`。eval 加了第 18 个用例。
- 为什么改：ADR-0150 E4（PR #31728）合并后引擎已这样解析，但技能没写，AI 会写出能加载、运行时却被拒、谁也不授权的规则。
- 风险与回滚：只改技能文字和 eval，不改任何运行时代码。为不超 token 上限，删了 9 处（共 459 字节）来抵付新段落（446 字节）：8 处是文件内别处已讲过的重复或作者用不到的包名指针，1 处是实质删减「旧 SQL 风格谓词仍经弃用桥编译」。逐条清单见下文和 changeset。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看：`skills/objectstack-data/rules/security.md` 第 169–175 行新段落；同文件其余删减；`evals/hooks-security-seeds-datasources.json` 的 id 18。
- 两分钟验证：`node scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs`，预期 security.md 一行显示 3764 tokens、ceiling 3768，退出 0。
- 需要你做的：审阅后批准本 PR（Tier H，`skills/**`）。

## What changes

- **`skills/objectstack-data/rules/security.md`** gains one bullet under the membership-key "Choose by what the rows are keyed on" bullet, the one that sends a team's records to a sharing rule with `sharedWith: { type: 'queue', value: QUEUE_NAME }`. It teaches what the merged engine does (`packages/plugins/plugin-sharing/src/sharing-rule-service.ts` `assertQueueRecipientReachable`, `packages/objectql/src/package-scoped-resolver.ts` `resolvePackageScopedName`):
  - a package's rule reads the queue name as its own package's queue, else the one holder in its declared `dependencies` closure plus `sys`, else, when no package or environment item declares the name, an organization's `sys_queue` row (the resolver's not-found passes through to the queue service);
  - refusal `outside-closure` (resolver L198, L408): the only holder is a package outside the closure, or an environment-authored item (D3 (a)); example: only a non-dependency holds `support`;
  - refusal `ambiguous-in-closure` (resolver L194, L399): two dependencies hold the name, and step 2 refuses before anything else is asked;
  - refusal `ambiguous-in-environment` (resolver L196, L360): the holder the rule reaches (its own package or one dependency) and a non-dependency both hold it; the package check passes, then the queue service, which has no caller package, refuses a name two packages hold (`package-scoped-declarations.ts` `resolveDeclaredName`; PR #31728's acceptance note, carrier #31734);
  - a refused rule grants no one new; the throw is `PackageScopedNameRefusedError`, `code = 'RESOURCE_CONFLICT'` (`package-scoped-declarations.ts` L181), warned once (`reportRefusedDeclaration`), and each recompute keeps the rule's standing grants (`sharing-rule-service.ts` L1511–1527).
- **Paid inside the file.** The token ceiling is 3768 and had 0 headroom on main. The new bullet (446 B) is paid for by nine cuts in the same file (459 B; 15069 → 15056 bytes, 3764 tokens):
  - `(PermissionSetSchema.rowLevelSecurity)` after "permission set / profile" (41 B). Survivor: the same sentence names `rowLevelSecurity` on a permission set.
  - "(the tenant wall still applies)" in the RLS default-deny sentence (32 B). Survivor: the Layer 0 bullet, "AND-composed ahead of all business RLS".
  - The sentence that a legacy SQL-style `=` / `IN (...)` predicate still compiles through a deprecated bridge (98 B). **Not a restatement**: the file now teaches canonical CEL only.
  - The four "(for `IN`)" notes in the `current_user.*` table (42 B). Survivor: `field in current_user.ARRAY` in the predicate list above.
  - The membership-key section intro, shortened to "Declare the set on the roster object, not one policy per record." (80 B). Survivors: the section heading and the "Choose by" bullet's "a named record → a membership key".
  - "(`isDefault` sets)" after the `everyone` baseline in the Positions section (19 B). Survivor: the `isDefault: true` bullet that defines it.
  - The admin-only recipe's `tenancy` comment "not a tenant object → Layer 0 contributes nothing" (55 B). Survivor: the blockquote below it.
  - The blockquote's "it is the half that holds however permissive the grants" (59 B). Survivor: the `requiredPermissions` paragraph (AND-gate, strictest-wins).
  - "(`@objectstack/plugin-security`)" after `sys_user_permission_set` (33 B), a package pointer an author never writes (seat ruling A).
  - Kept on the seat's rework: the `(definePermissionSet)` example comment and the field-lock recipe docs link.
- **`skills/objectstack-data/evals/hooks-security-seeds-datasources.json`** gains case **18**, placed right after the queue case 8: `com.acme.crm` shares escalated cases with `support_tier2`, the queue `com.acme.helpdesk` ships. `must_contain`: `type: 'queue'`, `dependencies`, `outside-closure`; `must_not_contain`: `name: 'support_tier2'` (redeclaring the queue in the rule's package makes a second holder, refused too). Ids 1–17 keep their numbers because changesets cite them.
- `SKILL.md` § Ownership queues (L425) read, not edited: no sentence there is false after E4 (it names the queue, the claim and the move; it says nothing about how a rule resolves the name).
- Changeset: `'@objectstack/skills': patch`.

## Tests

Docs and eval only; no runtime code moved, so no package suite is owed.

## Acceptance notes

- `ui/scripts/check-skill-eval-tokens.mjs` (exit 0) reads `skills/objectui/evals` only, so it does not grade case 18. Its three `must_contain` tokens were checked by hand as whole tokens of the bundle: all three are in `rules/security.md`, `dependencies` also in `references/_index.md`.
- Case 18 sits between ids 8 and 9 in the array, so the file's ids are no longer ascending; no reader in the repo indexes evals by position.
- `check:skill-examples` is not in the derived set and was not run: no `os:check` block was touched (the one edited code block, the admin-only recipe, is unmarked).
- Eval case 18 asserts `outside-closure` only, so the rework's split of the two ambiguity codes leaves it unchanged.
